title: red-tailed-hawk.wav
author: 1888software
description: This is a field recording made with a Zoom H1-N recorder. As we approached a nest in a tall Douglas fir tree, a red-tailed hawk flew out, landed in a tree near us, and called out constantly. Perhaps these calls were trying to distract us from the nest, where we could see, with binoculars, two young heads in the wide nest. This is a recording of four of those calls.
